g.text: C Quality at the frozen caps

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Does the proposal-quality advantage survive a measured-compute comparison?

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Matched-compute decision: supported. Quality-only gain: +67.71 pp (supported).

text.style: font-size: 10.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Source-selected caps frozen at 20,000 arbitrary / 12,000 permutation · identical weights, shared starts, temperature endpoints

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Fresh median time ratio = 0.975; required 0.90–1.10. Timing gate passes; the primary decision keeps this separate from quality.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Calibration uses source-derived N13-shaped clues, three search streams on both GPUs, a fixed grid and at most one interpolation.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: All calibration keys are excluded from the 4,096 fresh target inputs. Proposal counts are never adjusted after target costs are observed.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Total GPU-worker time, including calibration, warmups and target searches: 695.0s. Calibration costs are not omitted.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: The endpoints of the source temperature schedule are fixed; changing caps also changes annealing duration. All 491,520 scored states are audited.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: One inherited BP AdamW fit; three search seeds clustered per input. Equal-compute interpretation requires the declared realized-time gate.
